label: Financial Statement Narrative Drafter
description: Drafts narrative sections of financial statements (management commentary, notes, MD&A). Converts financial data into clear, compliant, board-quality narrative.

claudeKnowledge.description: IFRS financial statement disclosure requirements, Swedish ÅRL, management commentary best practice (IASB Practice Statement 1), MD&A guidance (SEC, FCA)

guidedInputs.label: Financial data and key figures
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Provide the financial data to be discussed. Include key P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow figures, plus comparatives.
e.g.
Revenue: 456 MSEK (2024), 387 MSEK (2023) — +18%
EBITDA: 89 MSEK (2024), 71 MSEK (2023) — margin 19.5% vs 18.3%
Net profit: 52 MSEK (2024), 39 MSEK (2023)
Cash: 94 MSEK at year-end (2023: 67 MSEK)
Net debt: 112 MSEK (2023: 145 MSEK)

guidedInputs.label: Business context and key events
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe the year's key events, strategic developments, market context, and operational highlights that should be reflected in the narrative.

guidedInputs.label: Specific notes or topics to include
guidedInputs.placeholder: Any specific disclosures, risks, or topics that must be covered. e.g. significant acquisition completed in November, going concern assessment, material litigation.
